text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Look, Mr. C.B. and Maruzensky are
talking
together!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I bet they're discussing incredibly
high-level race
techniques!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On my way to lunch, I spot two students
at the
center of a crowd. I'm looking on
absentmindedly
when suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Hey, you there! Would you mind
coming over
here for a sec?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Are you free to talk? I've got a question
for you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. has a stern look on her face. I
can tell
she's about to ask a complex
question about
racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hope I can provide a response
sophisticated
enough to show that I'm a
reputable trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: How can I get better at cooking?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
C.B. came to ask me for advice on living
alone.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm a little worried about her. And I'd
like her to
take good care of herself.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You live alone, right, Trainer? Don't you
have any
sweet tips to offer?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I'm a bit of a scatterbrain, you
know!
Some of the stuff I do would
probably give you a
good laugh!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
But cooking's such a hassle, right? I
always end up
making simple dishes like
fried rice.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You can't live like that! A racer's body is
her
greatest asset.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I learn that there's more to Mr. C.B. than
I
thought. Although I do find myself
wanting to
give her heaps of advice...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hm? Really?
choice_data_list: 俺も人のこと言えないからなぁ……
私も人のこと言えないからなぁ……

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ugh, tell me about it!
choice_data_list: 洗濯物とかすぐ溜めちゃうし……

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I hear that!
choice_data_list: 掃除とかいつも後回しだし

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm too lazy to cook every night, so I just
make a
massive portion of curry in
advance!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That great big washing machine in the
dorm really
comes in handy if you've got
a heap of laundry to
do. You can wash it
all at once.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And never store curry at room
temperature. It
spoils really fast, so
make sure you put it in the
fridge, or
freeze it right after cooking.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Heh, I guess a little. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Boy, living on your own makes you
appreciate
what your parents did for
you, huh!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Having someone cook three meals a day
for you
is pretty incredible when you
think about it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yes, I'd almost forgotten what this
was all
about.
choice_data_list: そういえば、料理について聞かれていたな
そういえば、料理について聞かれていたね

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ooh, did you get a flash of inspiration?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My conversation with Mr. C.B. painted a
clear
picture of a laid-back, orderless
lifestyle. The
best advice for someone
like her would be...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My conversation with Mr. C.B. painted a
clear
picture of a laid-back, orderless
lifestyle. The
best advice for someone
like her would be...
choice_data_list: 大雑把な料理も君らしさだ
大雑把な料理も貴方らしさだよ
自由な創作料理にチャレンジしよう！

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haha! You sure know how to give a
compliment.
choice_data_list: 大雑把な料理も君らしさだ
大雑把な料理も貴方らしさだよ
自由な創作料理にチャレンジしよう！

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I am Mr. C.B., after all. If
worrying
about the details keeps me
from having any fun,
then there's no
point!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, true. Fun is definitely the best
ingredient.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, you two! I'd like to invite you
both to
dinner to show my appreciation.
How about it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although Mr. C.B.'s approach to cooking
is
undoubtedly crude, the results are
delicious.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Something creative! I like the sound of
that!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I've cooked Italian food before,
for
example, but it's totes difficult. Are
you really up
for this?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, I have no idea how this is going to
turn out,
but I'm always up for a
challenge!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Time to enjoy some creative freedom.
This is
getting exciting!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mr. C.B. gets to work on some
original
dishes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She makes super sweet mapo tofu,

ramen-flavored pizza, and deep-fried
fruit...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
None of the dishes end up tasting very
good, but
after seeing how much fun she
had cooking
everything, I can't help but
feel happy myself,
too.
